::: {.book-summary} ## Book Summary Insight 2 Kings traces the decline and exile of Israel and Judah because of persistent unfaithfulness. The book demonstrates God's justice while preserving hope through His covenant promises. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 1
2 Kings 1:3
Is it because there is no God in Israel?
### Why This Verse Elijah confronts idolatry ### Chapter Insight This chapter records Ahaziah's inquiry of Baal-zebub and Elijah's response. The key verse demonstrates that God alone is the source of truth and guidance. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 2
2 Kings 2:11
Elijah went up by a whirlwind
### Why This Verse Elijah's translation to heaven ### Chapter Insight This chapter recounts Elijah's departure and Elisha's succession. The key verse emphasizes the continuation of God's work through faithful servants. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 3
2 Kings 3:17
Ye shall not see wind or rain
### Why This Verse God's miraculous provision ### Chapter Insight This chapter records God's deliverance of Israel through Elisha's prophecy. The key verse highlights God's provision even when circumstances seem impossible. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 4
2 Kings 4:43
They shall eat and have some left
### Why This Verse Memorable miracle of provision ### Chapter Insight This chapter contains several miracles through Elisha. The key verse demonstrates God's compassion and power to meet human needs. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 5
2 Kings 5:14
Naaman was clean
### Why This Verse Famous healing account ### Chapter Insight This chapter recounts Naaman's healing from leprosy. The key verse emphasizes humble faith and obedience to God's instructions. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 6
2 Kings 6:16
They that be with us are more than they that be with them
### Why This Verse One of the book's best-known verses ### Chapter Insight This chapter records miraculous deliverances and divine protection. The key verse reveals God's unseen presence surrounding His people. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 7
2 Kings 7:9
This day is a day of good tidings
### Why This Verse The lepers' realization ### Chapter Insight This chapter describes God's miraculous provision during a famine. The key verse highlights God's ability to reverse hopeless situations. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 8
2 Kings 8:13
Is thy servant a dog?
### Why This Verse Hazael prophecy ### Chapter Insight This chapter records prophecies concerning future kings and nations. The key verse demonstrates God's sovereign knowledge of coming events. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 9
2 Kings 9:22
What peace, so long as Jezebel's whoredoms remain?
### Why This Verse Jehu's confrontation ### Chapter Insight This chapter recounts Jehu's anointing and judgment upon Ahab's house. The key verse emphasizes God's faithfulness to fulfill His word. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 10
2 Kings 10:30
Thou hast done well in executing what is right
### Why This Verse Jehu commended ### Chapter Insight This chapter describes Jehu's destruction of Baal worship. The key verse highlights zeal for reform while exposing incomplete obedience. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 11
2 Kings 11:17
Jehoiada made a covenant
### Why This Verse National renewal ### Chapter Insight This chapter records the preservation and coronation of Joash. The key verse demonstrates God's protection of the Davidic line. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 12
2 Kings 12:15
They dealt faithfully
### Why This Verse Integrity in stewardship ### Chapter Insight This chapter recounts the repair of the Temple under Joash. The key verse emphasizes faithful stewardship of God's house. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 13
2 Kings 13:21
The dead man revived
### Why This Verse Remarkable Elisha miracle ### Chapter Insight This chapter describes Israel's decline yet continued mercy from God. The key verse highlights God's compassion despite covenant unfaithfulness. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 14
2 Kings 14:6
Fathers shall not be put to death for children
### Why This Verse Important justice principle ### Chapter Insight This chapter records the reigns of Amaziah and Jeroboam II. The key verse demonstrates how pride can lead to downfall. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 15
2 Kings 15:35
The people still sacrificed in high places
### Why This Verse Persistent spiritual problem ### Chapter Insight This chapter summarizes several kings and increasing instability. The key verse reveals the consequences of persistent spiritual compromise. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 16
2 Kings 16:3
He made his son pass through the fire
### Why This Verse Ahaz's apostasy ### Chapter Insight This chapter records Ahaz's idolatry and alliance with Assyria. The key verse highlights the danger of trusting human solutions over God. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 17
2 Kings 17:13
Turn from your evil ways
### Why This Verse Summary of prophetic warnings ### Chapter Insight This chapter recounts the fall of the Northern Kingdom of Israel. The key verse explains that judgment came because of persistent disobedience and idolatry. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 18
2 Kings 18:5
He trusted in the LORD
### Why This Verse Hezekiah's defining characteristic ### Chapter Insight This chapter introduces Hezekiah's reforms and faithfulness. The key verse emphasizes trust in God rather than political alliances. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 19
2 Kings 19:19
Save us, that all kingdoms may know You
### Why This Verse Hezekiah's prayer ### Chapter Insight This chapter records God's deliverance of Jerusalem from Assyria. The key verse demonstrates God's power to save those who trust Him. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 20
2 Kings 20:5
I have heard thy prayer
### Why This Verse Hezekiah healed ### Chapter Insight This chapter recounts Hezekiah's illness, healing, and failure. The key verse highlights both God's mercy and the danger of pride. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 21
2 Kings 21:16
Manasseh shed innocent blood
### Why This Verse Summary of his wickedness ### Chapter Insight This chapter describes the wicked reign of Manasseh. The key verse reveals the devastating effects of prolonged rebellion against God. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 22
2 Kings 22:13
Great is the wrath of the LORD
### Why This Verse Response to discovering the Law ### Chapter Insight This chapter records the discovery of the Book of the Law under Josiah. The key verse emphasizes the transformative power of God's word. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 23
2 Kings 23:25
No king like Josiah
### Why This Verse Josiah's unparalleled devotion ### Chapter Insight This chapter recounts Josiah's reforms and covenant renewal. The key verse highlights wholehearted devotion to God. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 24
2 Kings 24:3
Surely at the commandment of the LORD
### Why This Verse Judah's fall explained ### Chapter Insight This chapter records Judah's decline under Babylonian pressure. The key verse demonstrates the fulfillment of God's warnings through the prophets. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 25
2 Kings 25:27
Evil-merodach lifted up Jehoiachin's head
### Why This Verse Hope amid exile ### Chapter Insight This chapter describes the fall of Jerusalem and the exile. The key verse marks the tragic culmination of generations of covenant unfaithfulness while leaving a small note of hope. :::
